test_case_name: Access the 'Parla con noi' page from the homepage

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' link in the header
And then check that the 'Parla con Noi - Contatti e Orari d'Apertura - Intesa Sanpaolo' page is displayed

test_case_name: Accept all cookies on the 'Parla con noi' page after navigation

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' link in the header
Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed on the 'Parla con Noi - Contatti e Orari d'Apertura - Intesa Sanpaolo' page

test_case_name: Open privacy options from the cookie banner on the 'Parla con noi' page

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' link in the header
Click the 'Più opzioni' link in the cookie banner
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Initiate guest login on the 'Parla con noi' page

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' link in the header
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input field
Type $password in the 'Password' input field
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form
And then check that the user is logged in or receives a login response

test_case_name: Initiate guest login and select 'Mantieni L'accesso' on the 'Parla con noi' page

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' link in the header
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input field
Type $password in the 'Password' input field
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form
And then check that the user is logged in with the 'Mantieni L'accesso' option enabled
